title: Upkeep changes modeled monthly benefit
method: Synthetic planning model: eight hours at $75 costs $600 to implement; four monthly support hours at $75 cost $300. Net benefit is $600 minus $300. It excludes taxes, financing, growth and risk.
alt: Upkeep changes modeled monthly benefit. Gross reduction: 600 USD/month; Support effort: 300 USD/month; Net modeled benefit: 300 USD/month. Illustrative values.
